question.question: How do Vagabond refresh, Slip, normal Move and forest Rest work, including hostile destinations and Evening drawing?

expected.expected_answer: Refresh two exhausted items per tea already face up on track, then three more; newly refreshed tea does not boost that step. Slip optionally adjacent clearing/forest free boots even hostile, ignoring restrictions on moving out. Normal Move costs boot plus extra boot if hostile warriors at destination; cannot enter forest, may leave to adjacent clearing, rule ignored. Forest Rest repairs all damaged items and flips them face up; still draw one plus face-up coins on track then discard to five.

source_passages.quotation:
**Birdsong:**

1. **Refresh:** First count tea **already face up on Refresh track**; flip two exhausted items face up per counted tea, then three more exhausted items. Tea refreshed during this step gives no extra refresh this step. Refreshing changes face, not damaged status.
2. **Slip (optional):** Move to an adjacent clearing or forest, exhausting **no boots**, even into hostile warriors. Ignore all effects preventing movement **out of** a clearing. **Forest adjacency for Slip:** a forest is adjacent to clearings touching it without crossing a printed path, and to forests separated by one printed path. On Winter, the river also divides forests as paths do.

- **Move:** Exhaust one boot, plus **one extra boot** if destination has any warriors of any Hostile faction (also for forced moves). Ignore rule. **Cannot enter a forest with this action; from a forest you may move only to an adjacent clearing.** Slip has the special free-boot exception.

source_passages.section: Vagabond (9; V.1–3); Evening, all four steps
source_passages.quotation:
**Evening, all four steps:**

1. If in forest, **Rest**: return all damaged items to Satchel and flip them face up; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if able. This does not refresh undamaged exhausted items.
2. **Always draw**, even after forest Rest: one card plus one per face-up coins on track.
3. Discard hand to five.
4. **Capacity, the last step of Evening after drawing and discarding:** Satchel **plus Damaged box** may contain **six items plus two per face-up bag on its track**. Track items do not count toward load. Permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within limit. Do not check capacity immediately upon acquiring an item.

answer.ruling: At Birdsong Refresh, count tea already face up on the Refresh track, turn two exhausted items face up per such tea, then turn three more exhausted items face up. Tea refreshed in that step does not add refreshes in the same step; flipping items does not change damaged status. Slip is optional: move to an adjacent clearing or forest without exhausting boots, even into hostile warriors. Ignore effects that prevent movement out of a clearing. Forest adjacency for Slip is to clearings touching the forest without crossing a printed path and to forests one printed path away; on Winter, rivers also divide forests.

Exhaust one boot to move, plus one additional boot if the destination contains any warriors of any Hostile faction; this applies to forced moves too. Ignore rule. This action cannot enter a forest; from a forest, it can move only to an adjacent clearing. Slip is the special no-boot exception.

If in a forest during Evening, Rest by returning all damaged items to Satchel and flipping them face up; ready tea, coins and bags move to tracks if possible. Rest does not refresh undamaged exhausted items. Always draw one card plus one per face-up coin on the track, even after forest Rest; then discard to five. Capacity is checked at this final step: Satchel plus Damaged box may hold six items plus two per face-up bag on its track; track items do not count. Permanently remove chosen Satchel or Damaged items until within the limit. Do not check capacity immediately when acquiring an item.
